build_BertForReranking_model: build a BERT-based reranking model with a classifier head for multiple choice classification
run_BertReranker_rerank: run the BERT reranker to score and rank entity candidates for a list of mentions
create_BertReranker_optimizer: create an AdamW optimizer and warmup linear scheduler for fine-tuning the BERT reranking model
process_mentions_BertReranker: process mentions and candidates into tokenized tensors ready for the BERT reranking model
get_candidate_representation_BertReranke: get a tokenized BERT input representation combining context tokens with a candidate entity description
